confirmed_findings.finding: Valid but wrong hints can harm other traffic
confirmed_findings.evidence: 2080Ti addendum: misleading advice raises unhinted meanTTFT14.6%; all four fixed blocks show pressure and actual no-return key touches
confirmed_findings.limit: Stress workload; no broad population latency or unique causal stall attribution
confirmed_findings.remediation_direction: Budget and feedback for shared-cache interference; do not equate a valid observed prefix with useful advice

confirmed_findings.finding: Bounded operating mode loses advice for new sessions after lifetime registry capacity
confirmed_findings.evidence: Cap2 probe refuses third session after both previous requests finish; documented default4096 lifetime identities
confirmed_findings.limit: Base model serving continues; not a GPU leak or an observed Stage6 saturation
confirmed_findings.remediation_direction: Design bounded session retirement/epochs and replay protection together; do not simply delete tombstones

confirmed_findings.finding: Positive refresh count is much weaker than preserving useful returning KV
confirmed_findings.kind: Observed coverage and utility weakness with CPU-demonstrated selected-policy blind spot
confirmed_findings.evidence: Qwen8B half-cache documents:3267 positive refreshes, zero full CPU-prefix-ready acknowledgements, median CPU-prefix extent4.4%; CPU probe default misses a ready CPU suffix behind a GPU-resident root
confirmed_findings.limit: CPU-only extent is not total GPU+CPU reuse and is not a new failure rule; optional bridge exists but was not selected
confirmed_findings.remediation_direction: Measure demand-reachable GPU+CPU coverage and later useful consumption, not just acknowledgements or bytes

confirmed_findings.finding: Conflicting retry payload can return cached acknowledgement before namespace validation
confirmed_findings.evidence: Same eventID with changed model namespace returns old positive acknowledgement; new eventID correctly rejects namespace
confirmed_findings.limit: No second cache action occurs; no incorrect-modelKV reuse; not observed in unique campaign IDs
confirmed_findings.remediation_direction: Bind idempotency results to complete validated payload and reject key conflicts

confirmed_findings.finding: Non-object JSON producesHTTP500 instead of client error
confirmed_findings.evidence: JSONlist/null/int/string each500; invalid object400; scheduler never called
confirmed_findings.limit: Request failure only; no model crash or cache mutation
confirmed_findings.remediation_direction: Validate mapping shape before field access and return a client error

confirmed_findings.finding: Public hint contract remains tied to benchmark wait estimates and one clock domain
confirmed_findings.evidence: Only0/50/250/750ms estimates accepted;1000/2000 rejected; absent estimate yields no action; shared-monotonic-clock requirement
confirmed_findings.limit: Not a failure of the supported local750ms client path
confirmed_findings.remediation_direction: Define general bounded estimates, clock translation and application integration requirements before claiming general support
